To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) a single example of a new class is sufficient for learning a new classification task; (2) feature replacement is a powerful tool for learning a novel class; (3) feature replacement is robust across 107 different object categories.

(1) the proposed method can learn a novel category from a single example, and (2) the method can be applied to a wide variety of object categories, and (3) the proposed method outperforms a baseline method that does not use feature adaptation.
we have developed a method for learning novel classes from single examples that uses features from familiar classes to adapt the feature space for the new class.
In summary, our research is concerned with
learning new classes from a single image example.
the generalization of knowledge from already learned classes to novel classes.
the question: how can a single example of a new class be used to improve classification performance of an object recognition system?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the proposed method is able to learn a novel class by replacing features from already learned familiar classes with features from the novel class, and thereby achieve useful classification performance.
the proposed method is capable of learning a novel class from one single example, and that this performance gain can be attributed to the feature adaptation concept.
our proposed method is a novel approach for learning a novel class from one example.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we can learn to recognize a novel class by looking at a single example of that class, and we can do so by replacing features of already learned classes with features of the novel class.
we have developed a novel classification method that can be trained with very limited training data.
we propose a method for learning new classes from a single training image, using a set of already learned classes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the features learned from familiar classes can be used to bootstrap the learning of a novel class.
the feature replacement strategy can be applied to any classifier and any type of features.
feature replacement is a powerful concept for generalizing to novel classes.
